scope: Post-hoc three-arm coordinate-update ablation on the previously evaluated FEM-v2 benchmark; encoded-graph E(3) symmetry only, not a blind benchmark, raw-layout equivariance claim, or general proof that coordinate updates help

normalization.coordinate_scale: max(sqrt(mean squared raw edge-relative Euclidean norm over training edges), 1e-6)
normalization.target_transform: log1p positive reference; train mean and population std; inverse expm1 without clipping

optimization.model_selection: fixed final epoch; validation is diagnostic only

initialization.same_width_common_state: copy every matching non-coordinate tensor from fixed96 into strict96 and verify exact initial hashes
initialization.fixed_matched_state: reset the same cell seed before construction; no tensor-wise shape pairing claim

trained_symmetry_gate.fixtures: lowest layout ID from each validation family
trained_symmetry_gate.orthogonal_transforms: alternating determinant +1 and -1 QR transforms with translations uniform on [-2,2] raw coordinate units
trained_symmetry_gate.permutation: one deterministic independent node permutation per graph and transform; topology remapped exactly
trained_symmetry_gate.relative_residual: maximum absolute difference divided by max(1, maximum absolute expected state)

evaluation.primary_metric: per-target family-macro MAPE percent on frozen test families
evaluation.difference_unit: percentage points; positive favors the fixed-coordinate control
evaluation.aggregate: mean over the fixed 25 cells; retain every cell

resampling.semantics: descriptive crossed-axis seed-grid sensitivity interval, not a population confidence interval

evaluation.historical_gnn: contextual comparison only; not a controlled ablation arm and excluded from primary paired contrasts

retry_policy: one fixed full array; preserve failures; any training retry requires a new protocol identity

checkpoint.format: three arm-specific numeric NPZ bundles; allow_pickle=False; no executable serialization

sandbox.training_files: selected split-scoped train and validation table plus this task's initially empty output directory only; no test, R4, other split, other task, prior GNN, baseline, accepted-set or finalizer bytes
